title: And after that?
goal: Tell a short story in order and give reasons: önce, sonra, ondan sonra, en sonunda, çünkü, bu yüzden, yine de.

intro.text: To tell a story in order: *önce* (first), *sonra* (then), *ondan sonra* (after that), *en sonunda* (in the end). *Çünkü* gives the cause, *bu yüzden* the result: *Otobüsü kaçırdım, bu yüzden geç kaldım*. *Yine de* means **still, even so**.

vocab.en: first, at first (alone, at the start of a step)

exercises.question: Why was the narrator late for the meeting?

context.en: Yesterday morning, first I missed the bus.

context.tr: Ondan sonra taksiye bindim, ama trafik çok kötüydü.
context.en: After that I took a taxi, but the traffic was very bad.
So I was late for the meeting.

context.tr: Akşam eve dönerken yağmur yağdı ve şemsiyem yoktu.
context.en: In the evening, on the way back home, it rained and I had no umbrella.

context.tr: Yine de güzel bir gündü, çünkü akşam arkadaşlarımla buluşup yemek yedik.
context.en: Still, it was a nice day, because in the evening I met my friends and we had dinner.

options: The bus was missed and the traffic was bad.

why.1: The text doesn't say so: the problem was the bus, then the traffic.
why.2: The rain came in the evening, on the way home.

exercises.explain: *Önce otobüsü kaçırdım … trafik çok kötüydü. Bu yüzden … geç kaldım.*

exercises.en: I missed the bus, so I was late.
exercises.explain: *Bu yüzden* introduces the result: **so, that's why**.

exercises.en: I was late because I missed the bus.

exercises.prompt: First I had breakfast, then I went to work.
accept: Önce kahvaltı yaptım, sonra işe gittim.
Önce kahvaltı yaptım, ondan sonra işe gittim.
Önce kahvaltı yapıp sonra işe gittim.
Önce kahvaltı yaptım, sonra da işe gittim.
Ben önce kahvaltı yaptım, sonra (da) işe gittim.

reject.answer: Önce kahvaltı yaptım, bu yüzden işe gittim.

exercises.prompt: Hava çok soğuktu, yine de denize girdik.
accept: It was very cold; still, we went into the sea.
It was very cold, but we still went [into the sea|in the sea|swimming].
The weather was very cold; still, we went into the sea.
It was very cold; even so, we went [into the sea|swimming].
It was very cold, but we went into the sea anyway.

exercises.en: In the end the bus came.

exercises.prompt: I was ill, so I didn't come.

accept: Önce ellerini yıka.
Önce ellerinizi yıkayın.
Ellerini önce yıka.
Ellerinizi önce yıkayın.

reject.why: *Your hands* are a definite object: *ellerini*, with the accusative.

exercises.question: Which sentence means **I went home and went to bed**?

why.1: *Giderken* is **on the way**: you can't go to bed on the way home.

exercises.explain: `-Ip` links two actions one after the other: *gidip yattım*. `-ken` is for something that happens **during** another.

exercises.tr: Önce duş aldım, sonra kahvaltı yaptım.
exercises.en: First I had a shower, then I had breakfast.
options: Önce duş aldım, sonra kahvaltı yaptım.
Önce kahvaltı yaptım, sonra duş aldım.
Önce duş aldım, yine de kahvaltı yaptım.

accept: You are late again!
You were late again!
You came late again!

exercises.prompt: In the end we went home and slept.
accept: En sonunda eve gidip uyuduk.
En sonunda eve gittik ve uyuduk.
En sonunda eve gidip yattık.
Sonunda eve [gidip uyuduk|gidip yattık|gittik ve uyuduk].
En sonunda biz eve [gidip uyuduk|gidip yattık|gittik ve uyuduk].
